propositions: A bare repository fixture created with `git init --bare` and pushed into spawns detached background `git maintenance run --auto --quiet --detach` processes that outlive the push command, causing concurrent mutations to the object database.

When `shutil.copytree` immediately follows a push into such a fixture, it races against background maintenance repacking loose objects, causing the copy to fail with "No such file or directory" for loose-object fanout directories mid-walk, not merely `maintenance.lock`.

The fix applies three upkeep pins (`receive.autogc=false`, `gc.autoDetach=false`, `maintenance.autoDetach=false`) to fixture bare remotes before anything is pushed, eliminating the background mutator entirely rather than tolerating or narrowing the race window.

The guard test `test_fixture_bare_remote_leaves_no_detached_upkeep_behind_a_push` verifies that no `git maintenance run --detach` child survives a push by inspecting `GIT_TRACE2_EVENT` output, with a positive control asserting `receive-pack` was recorded so the trace cannot be vacuous.
